d: Uttar pradesh ki sima se bihar men nae ganga setu pul ke raste sharab ki bari khep khapane ki taskaron ki sajish ko baksar utpad vibhag ne nakam kar diya hai. vir kunvar sinh ganga setu chekpost par janch se bachkar bairiyar torte hue bhag rahi ek sandigdh lagjari bina yatri ki bas (sankhya AR06B6011) ko utpad vibhag ki tim ne philmi andaj men pichha kar enaech-922 par ahirauli sthit sarasvati vidya mandir skul ke samip gherabandi kar pakar liya. is puri karravaee ka laiv vidiyo bhi kaimre men kaid huaa hai.
